steps.thought: I will list all available tests on the station to understand what diagnostic tools and their corresponding costs we have for this drone.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to quickly check all communication buses and initial device enumeration across all subsystems.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest failed because I2C devices 'imu' and 'compass' were not found, and no I2C devices were found at all, pointing to an I2C communication or connection fault.

hypotheses.rationale: Missing I2C devices during boot strongly suggests a loose or disconnected I2C connector.
Could be a broader power or bus failure affecting the I2C line, though connector is most likely.

steps.thought: I will run harness_continuity to check the wiring and continuity of the I2C bus harness and determine if there is a break or loose connection.
steps.observation: The harness continuity test confirms an intermittent I2C connection with 3.54 ohms resistance, while power_on_selftest failed to find both the IMU and compass on the I2C bus. This strongly points to a loose or compromised I2C connector.

hypotheses.rationale: Missing I2C devices during boot combined with intermittent I2C bus continuity and elevated resistance directly isolates the failure to the I2C connector or its harness.
A localized PCB trace fracture or sensor power rail failure on the I2C bus is possible, but less likely than a loose connector.

steps.thought: The I2C connector is loose, causing both the IMU and compass to disappear from the bus intermittently or completely. I will now propose the rework to reseat the I2C connector.
steps.observation: Rework applied; full suite passed: True.
